title: thymus serpyllum f. porcii
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. porcii, commonly known as the wild thyme, is a subspecies of the thyme plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Thymus serpyllum f. porcii are attributed to its ability to act as a nervine, a sedative, and an expectorant, helping to calm the nervous system, induce relaxation, and facilitate the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, such as thymol and carvacrol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
